units.source_text: 层叠的山峦盘绕着厚厚的积云，活像一只大手在空中伸展，翻动，

en.t: Layered mountain ridges coiled around thick banks of cumulus cloud, just like a great hand stretching and turning in the sky,

units.source_text: 互相压挤着飞将过来，一派磅礴的气势。

en.t: pressing against one another as they seemed to fly toward us with a magnificent force.

units.source_text: 从云缝隙可以清楚地看到部分天空，突然又被云朵覆盖住。

en.t: Through gaps in the clouds, parts of the sky could be seen clearly, only to be suddenly covered over again.

units.source_text: 然而，薄薄的云层掠过时，透过薄云还可以看到勾划出朦胧光环的月亮。

en.t: Yet when a thin layer of cloud swept past, the moon could still be seen through the veil, tracing a hazy halo of light.
